name: Extreme wide
note: Subject tiny, the place is the star. Strong opener.

name: Wide
note: Whole body with plenty of setting around it.

name: Full shot
note: Head to toe with a little air. Shows the whole move.

name: Medium wide
note: Knees up. Body language plus some setting.

name: Medium
note: Waist up. Talking, gestures, reactions.

name: Medium close-up
note: Chest up. Emotion with a hint of outfit.

name: Close-up
note: Face fills the frame. The feeling of the moment.

name: Extreme close-up
note: Eyes and brow only. Focus, tension, intimacy.

name: Insert: hands
note: Hands holding, tying, grabbing. Small action, big clarity.

name: Insert: feet
note: Shoes and ground. Steps, stance, arrival.

name: Detail
note: A prop or texture that tells the story.

name: Establishing
note: Where are we? Town, venue or trailhead from afar.

name: Eye level
note: Lens at eye height. Neutral and honest.

name: Low angle
note: Camera below, looking up. Subject feels big.

name: Worm's eye
note: Camera on the ground. Towering and dramatic.

name: High angle
note: Camera above, looking down. Subject feels small.

name: Top-down
note: Straight down. Shapes, patterns, floor work.

name: Dutch angle
note: Tilted horizon. Energy, fun, unease.

name: Above the crowd
note: Phone held high over heads. Size of the crowd.

name: Ground level
note: Lens just above the floor. Ground leads the eye in.

name: Drone high
note: High and far. Route, shape of the land, scale.

name: Profile
note: Side-on. Clean shape of walks, jumps and kicks.

name: Rule of thirds
note: Subject on a third line, horizon on another.

name: Symmetry
note: Dead center, both sides match. Bold and calm.

name: Frame in frame
note: Arch, doorway or branches around the subject.

name: Leading lines
note: Paths, rails and stairs pointing to the subject.

name: Negative space
note: Lots of empty sky or wall. Mood, room for text.

name: Silhouette
note: Subject dark against a bright sky or light.

name: Reflection
note: Puddle, lake, window or mirror doubles the subject.

name: Foreground frame
note: Leaves, grass or a railing close to the lens.

name: Depth layers
note: Foreground, subject, background. Three planes.

name: Lead room
note: Leave space where the subject moves or looks.

name: Tight crop
note: Cut the top of the head, never the chin.

name: Shadow play
note: Film the shadow on a wall, not the dancer.

name: Split frame
note: Two halves: two places, people, or times.

name: Two-shot
note: Two people in one frame. Duet, chat, friendship.

name: Group
note: Everyone in frame. Crew, class, team.

name: Over the shoulder
note: From behind one person onto the other.

name: POV
note: What the subject sees. Hands in frame sell it.

name: Reaction
note: Cut to a face reacting. Surprise, awe, a laugh.

name: Crowd
note: Heads fill the frame. Scale and buzz.

name: Audience from stage
note: From behind the performer onto the crowd.

name: Stage from audience
note: Backs of heads, stage beyond. You are there.

name: Mirrored partners
note: Two dancers mirror each other across the center.

name: Selfie / vlog
note: Arm toward the lens. Check-ins and talking.

name: Walk and talk
note: Two side by side, camera walking backward.

name: Hero in the crowd
note: One person clear, everyone else is texture.

name: Pan
note: Camera turns left or right on the spot.

name: Tilt up
note: Tip up from feet to face. A reveal.

name: Tilt down
note: Sky or peak down to the subject. An arrival.

name: Push in
note: Move closer. Builds focus and emotion.

name: Pull out
note: Move away. Reveals the place, ends a scene.

name: Tracking side
note: Camera moves alongside at the same speed.

name: Follow from behind
note: Behind the subject, moving with them.

name: Lead
note: Camera walks backward in front of the subject.

name: Orbit
note: Circle around the subject. 360 energy.

name: Crane up
note: Camera rises and the view opens up.

name: Whip pan
note: Very fast pan that blurs. Energy or a cut.

name: Handheld
note: Slight shake. Raw and in the moment.

name: Crash zoom
note: Snap zoom onto a face. Comedy or punch.

name: Rack focus
note: Focus jumps from foreground to subject.

name: Rise over
note: Climb over a ridge or wall to show what is behind.

name: Reveal
note: Slide out from behind a wall, tree or person.

name: Low follow
note: Gimbal near the floor, following the steps.

name: Roll
note: Camera turns on its axis. Dreamy or a transition.

name: Dolly zoom
note: Move in while zooming out. Background warps.

name: Formation wide
note: The whole group. Spacing and lines.

name: Footwork
note: Feet only. Steps, slides and stomps.

name: Arm lines
note: Upper body. Clean lines and hand shapes.

name: Spin
note: Hold wide on a turn, or orbit with it.

name: Jump freeze
note: Catch the top of the jump.

name: Low kick
note: Camera near the floor, dancer towers.

name: Top-down circle
note: From above the group becomes a shape.

name: Studio mirror
note: Dancer and reflection, two angles at once.

name: Backlit
note: Light behind the dancer. Pure shape.

name: Hair flip
note: Close on the head for flips and head snaps.

name: Entrance
note: Empty frame, then the dancer steps in.

name: Final pose
note: Hold the last pose. Thumbnail and ending.

name: Partner lift
note: Frame wide enough for both bodies.

name: Beat cuts
note: Same move, three sizes. Cut on each beat.

name: Hands
note: Snaps, waves, hand shapes. Punctuation.

name: Wave / canon
note: Line of dancers, move ripples down the line.

name: Trailhead
note: Sign, start of the path. The day begins.

name: Summit hero
note: Arms up on top. The payoff shot.

name: Boots on trail
note: Boots, dust and rocks. Trail texture.

name: Pack from behind
note: Back to camera, pack on, view ahead.

name: Pass-by
note: Static camera, hiker crosses the frame.

name: POV with poles
note: Your view: poles, boots or hands in frame.

name: Taking in the view
note: Back to camera. We look with them.

name: Map and compass
note: Hands on map, phone or compass.

name: Stream crossing
note: Stepping stones, moving water, balance.

name: Sunrise silhouette
note: Sun on the horizon behind the hiker.

name: Scale shot
note: Tiny person, huge mountain.

name: Rest break
note: Sitting, drinking, snacks. A breather.

name: Gear flat lay
note: Top-down on your kit before you leave.

name: Trail marker
note: Red-white-red CAI mark on a rock. Local detail.

name: Coastal path
note: Cliff path above the sea, coast in frame.

name: Ridge follow
note: Above and behind along a ridge line.

name: Venue
note: Outside the venue. Lights on, people arriving.

name: Stage wide
note: Whole stage, lights and crowd edge.

name: Hands up
note: Arms up at the drop. Pure energy.

name: Performer from below
note: From the stage lip. Rock-star feel.

name: Front row
note: Right at the barrier, hands in frame.

name: Lights close-up
note: Out-of-focus lights. B-roll and cuts.

name: Glasses clink
note: Glasses meeting up close. Cheers.

name: Toast
note: People raising glasses together.

name: Laughing close-up
note: Real laughter up close. Gold in the edit.

name: Backstage
note: Waiting, nerves, prep behind the curtain.

name: Arrival
note: Walking in the door. The story starts.

name: Sign or banner
note: Event name, poster, menu board. Sets context.

name: Fireworks
note: Sky over the town, heads for scale.

name: Dance floor
note: Find one person to follow in the mix.

name: Candid two-shot
note: Two people talking, not posing.

name: DJ hands
note: Hands on decks, mixer or instrument.

name: Match cut
note: Same pose in two places. Cut between them.

name: Whip in, whip out
note: Whip out of one shot and into the next.

name: Cover the lens
note: A hand covers the lens. The cut hides inside.

name: Object wipe
note: Something passes close to the lens.

name: Jump cut
note: Same frame, subject jumps position.

name: Speed ramp
note: Fast then slow, landing on the key move.

name: Cutaway
note: Environment detail to cover a cut or breathe.

name: Tilt to sky
note: Tilt up to sky, cut, tilt down somewhere new.

name: Band wide
note: The whole band on stage, dancers at the edge.

name: Singer at the mic
note: Vintage mic, spotlight, a little lean in.

name: Trumpet solo
note: From below, the bell pointing out of the frame.

name: Sax solo
note: Player in profile, body moving with the line.

name: Double bass slap
note: Player and bass together, hands on the strings.

name: Drums
note: Kit in front, drummer behind. Hits on the beat.

name: Swing-out
note: The signature move. Wide, low and on the side.

name: Dip
note: The ending. Hold still and shoot it low.

name: Aerial
note: Frame wide with headroom, the follow flies over.

name: Charleston side by side
note: Two dancers, same kicks, facing camera.

name: Jam circle
note: Everyone around, one couple in the middle.

name: Dancers with the band
note: Couple in front, band behind. Both in one frame.

name: Two-tone shoes
note: Heel-toe, kicks, slides. Swing in close-up.

name: Hat tip
note: Era details: hat, braces, pearls.

name: Clapping on the beat
note: Crowd clapping, one person clear.

name: Underarm turn
note: Lead hand up, follow spins under it.

name: Over the bell
note: Past the horn player onto the dancers.

name: Piano hands
note: Hands on the keys. Rhythm you can see.
